card.name: Counterfactual "had" and historical dates
card.fires_on: The word "had" or "would" in hypothetical "if he had / if it had worked" clauses about what could have happened in history. Also fires on digits and months inside past years in historical narration.

modes.label: Hypothetical if-clauses
modes.description: "had" or "would" in an if-clause describing an unreal past possibility.
modes.example: he could have captured the seat of the Confederacy if he<< had>> had those extra troops at his command.

modes.label: Years in history
modes.description: A digit or month inside a past date in a historical account.
modes.example: The cornerstone for the cathedral was laid in 185<<8>>, but construction was stopped during the years

card.writes: It favors words of reality, preliminary state and "increasingly", and discourages "until now" and "since" phrasing.
card.plain: It marks "what if" statements about the past and the middle of old dates in history writing.
